build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Primary mechanic A is complete and playable: Note chart and playback system. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

Primary mechanic B is complete and connected to A: Timing detection and judgment. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

Primary mechanics C and D both affect live play: Combo, score, and accuracy; Song select and difficulty tiers. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

At least four supporting systems are implemented and connected: Audio clock as the single source of timing truth; Note chart data format placed against a track; Scrolling note playback synced to the audio clock; Input-to-note timing windows: perfect, good, miss; Combo multiplier and score accumulation; Accuracy percentage and letter-grade calculation; Hit, miss, and combo visual and audio feedback; Song select with multiple difficulties per track. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

Provide a short session with escalating pace, score and combo logic, at least three challenge patterns, a high-score result, and an immediate replay flow. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

The rules layer maintains resources, objectives, selection, danger, progress, and outcome without relying on DOM text as the source of truth. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

A three-stage progression teaches the core mechanic, combines systems under greater pressure, and ends with a mastery scenario plus a working replay flow. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

The HUD clearly communicates current objective, critical resources, selected target or mode, progress, and danger in stable regions. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

Important actions have immediate, distinguishable feedback for valid input, invalid input, success, damage or failure, and state changes. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

The full loop is connected: styled start flow, playable systems, escalation, final success/failure state, and retry navigation work without page reload. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

The project has a coherent authored art direction: Immediate arcade readability, energetic motion, saturated accents against a restrained background, and celebratory score and combo feedback. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

The 2D front-facing composition uses deliberate lighting, contrast, depth or layering, and themed landmarks instead of an empty default scene. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Interactive actors, targets, hazards, tools, and UI symbols have readable silhouettes and visibly different functional states. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Movement, impacts, transitions, alerts, completion moments, and interface changes use smooth multi-frame animation, particles, camera treatment, or synchronized audio feedback. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.
